hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Intentional muted-pastel palette and clean card layout show real design thought, but the edge bundles tangle into an unreadable mass at the root and the visualization is cropped before the full circle-pack is visible, undermining the core data encoding.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: scaleSqrt correctly used for force-layout node sizing, d3.pack handles area-based circles natively, data-driven domains via d3.extent/root.height, and key functions present on both node and link data joins.
flags: Update Storm: tension slider fires redrawLinks() (300 link path redraws) on every input event with no RAF throttle or debounce
Update Storm: easing param sliders call updateLayout() on every input event, restarting a 1500ms transition repeatedly mid-drag
Broken Guard: svg.selectAll('.transitioning') check is dead code — .transitioning class is never applied anywhere, so the tension-slider guard always passes even during transitions
Mid-Flight Snap: no explicit .interrupt() call on nodeSelection before new layout transitions; easing/param sliders constantly restart in-flight 1500ms transitions without clearing prior state
Mouse-Touch Fight: no event.preventDefault() or pointer-event filtering to prevent double-trigger from simultaneous mouse and touch events on drag
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: The tension and easing-param sliders both trigger expensive unthrottled DOM mutations at input-event frequency (60fps), and a broken .transitioning guard means the only attempted rate-limit never fires.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle pack hierarchy reads cleanly with a restrained 4-color palette, but the edge bundles converge into a dense central tangle that obscures all connection structure — the spaghetti threshold is breached at the root, making individual links untraceable without hover interaction.
